title: Reefer Cargo Services: Goodwill Fee Waivers
content:
The service desk may, at a customer's request, forgive a Reefer Cargo Services fee as goodwill. This page sets out which fees can be forgiven, the extent of a waiver, and the limits of amount, frequency and time within which the desk may act.

## Clause

A goodwill waiver is granted on the customer's request and relates to one fee entry. Only four kinds of fee entry qualify: a setting change fee, a late request fee, a cancellation fee and a plug-in and monitoring charge. Inspection fees, special service charges and remote monitoring fees are never waived. A waiver removes the whole of the fee entry it refers to, never part of it. All of the following must hold, judged from the line's charge records and measured against the tier of the service the fee belongs to:

- **Amount.** The fee entry is no larger than the tier's waiver authority; an entry equal to the authority is within it.
- **Frequency.** The customer's goodwill waivers on reefer services within the trailing 365 calendar days are fewer than the tier's allowance. That span ends on the date of the waiver being considered, which is itself included, and it counts waivers across every reefer service of the customer.
- **Time.** The request is made within the tier's request window. The window closes on the date the fee was booked plus the window length, counted in calendar dates, and a request on the closing day is inside it.
- **Once only.** The fee entry has not already been waived.

If the amount exceeds the authority, or the customer's waivers in the span already equal or exceed the allowance, no waiver is granted.

## Eligibility of fee kinds

| Fee kind | Can be waived as goodwill? |
|---|---|
| Setting change fee | yes |
| Late request fee | yes |
| Cancellation fee | yes |
| Plug-in and monitoring charge | yes |
| Inspection fee (first or repeat) | never |
| Special service charge | never |
| Remote monitoring fee | never |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical figures and dates)

- With an imagined authority of 80.00, a fee entry of 80.00 can be waived and one of 80.01 cannot. A waiver of the 80.00 entry removes all 80.00.
- With an imagined window of 20 days, a fee booked on 15 January 2026 can be waived on a request made up to and including 4 February 2026, but not on 5 February.
- For a waiver considered on 10 May 2026, the span runs from 11 May 2025 to 10 May 2026. A waiver dated 11 May 2025 counts towards the allowance; one dated 10 May 2025 does not. With an imagined allowance of two and two waivers already in the span, no further waiver is granted.
- A plug-in charge that was waived once cannot be waived a second time.
